title: Ordinary model comparison from a raw transported counit square
statement: Let R0,A0,B0,C0 and R,A,B,C be commutative rings in a common universe, with algebra structures R0→A0,R0→B0,A0⊗[R0]B0→C0 and R→A,R→B,A⊗[R]B→C. Choose derived categories of R0,B0 and R,B, possibly in different morphism universes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let Q0,Q be complexes of A0,A modules and M,N their base-derived tensor cohomology models [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Fix ring equivalences eA:A0≃A,eB:B0≃B and a chain isomorphism q:Q0≅restriction_eA(Q). Fix a ring equivalence eE:A0⊗[R0]B0≃A⊗[R]B with eE(a⊗b)=eA(a)⊗eB(b), and a chain isomorphism s from the ordinary A0-to-A0⊗B0 extension of Q0 to restriction_eE of the ordinary A-to-A⊗B extension of Q, satisfying s(r⊗x)=eE(r)⊗q(x) in every degree. Fix degree i. Write T0,T for termwise extension from R0,R to B0,B, P0,P for complex localization followed by M.derived,N.derived and degree-i homology, and c0,c for homology of their counits composed with the derived and homotopy homology factorization isomorphisms. Let K0,K be Q0,Q restricted to the base rings. Given an ordinary chain isomorphism v:T0(K0)≅restriction_eB(T(K)) sending b⊗x to eB(b)⊗q(x), a B0-linear map f on the raw derived cohomology whose square with the raw counits c0,c commutes through H^i(v), and a B0-linear map k on the restricted model cohomology satisfying k followed by restriction(cohomologyIso_N) = cohomologyIso_M followed by f, the model comparison square commutes on every element: inverse exact-restriction homology along eE applied to N.comparison(k(x)) equals H^i(s)(M.comparison(x)). Neither k nor f need be invertible; no universality hypothesis is used beyond the recorded model equations.

proof.text: Prove that forgetting commutes with the exact-restriction homology isomorphism. Compare twice-mapped and directly mapped left homology data by identity maps; ShortComplex.LeftHomologyMapData.homologyMap_comm supplies the equality. Combine it with ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality to obtain the forgotten homology-map formula.

Substitute M.comparison_eq and N.comparison_eq, compose with the restriction homology isomorphisms, and forget to additive groups. The preceding homology formula expresses both comparisons using the raw counits and the ordinaryIso maps.

The additive chain square ordinaryIso_M followed by s equals v followed by ordinaryIso_N holds on b tensor x by ordinaryIso_tmul, hv, hs and heE at 1 tensor b. Tensor induction proves it on all elements and hence on chain maps.

Forget hk and hf. Substitute the two comparison formulas, cancel the intermediate homology isomorphisms and apply homology to the chain square. The forgotten homology-map formula for s identifies the final exact-restriction map. Evaluate at x and apply the inverse isomorphism to obtain the asserted equality.

theorem baseDerivedTensor_ring_counit_square
    {R₀ A₀ B₀ C₀ R A B C : Type u}
    [CommRing R₀] [CommRing A₀] [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀]
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra R₀ A₀] [Algebra R₀ B₀] [Algebra (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) C₀]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) C]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R₀)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} B₀)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (Q₀ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A₀) ℤ)
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (M : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R₀ A₀ B₀ Q₀ C₀)
    (N : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q C)
    (eA : A₀ ≃+* A) (eB : B₀ ≃+* B)
    (q : Q₀ ≅ ((restrictScalars.{u} eA.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
    (eE : (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) ≃+* (A ⊗[R] B))
    (heE : ∀ (a : A₀) (b : B₀), eE (a ⊗ₜ[R₀] b) = eA a ⊗ₜ[R] eB b)
    (s : ((extendScalars (algebraMap A₀ (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj Q₀ ≅
      ((restrictScalars.{u} eE.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((extendScalars (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
    (hs : ∀ (j : ℤ) (r : A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) (x : Q₀.X j),
      s.hom.f j (r ⊗ₜ[A₀,algebraMap A₀ (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀)] x) =
        eE r ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)] (show Q.X j from q.hom.f j x))
    (i : ℤ) :
    let π₀ := HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R₀) (.up ℤ)
    let π := HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)
    let H₀ := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B₀) i
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i
    let P₀ := π₀ ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ M.derived ⋙ H₀
    let P := π ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ N.derived ⋙ H
    let U := restrictScalars.{u} eB.toRingHom
    let T₀ := (extendScalars (algebraMap R₀ B₀)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let T := (extendScalars (algebraMap R B)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let c₀ := fun K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R₀) ℤ ↦
      H₀.map (M.counit.app (π₀.obj K)) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactorsh (ModuleCat.{u} B₀) i).hom.app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj (T₀.obj K)) ≫
        (HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctorFactors (ModuleCat.{u} B₀) (.up ℤ) i).hom.app
          (T₀.obj K)
    let c := fun K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ ↦
      H.map (N.counit.app (π.obj K)) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactorsh (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).hom.app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj (T.obj K)) ≫
        (HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctorFactors (ModuleCat.{u} B) (.up ℤ) i).hom.app
          (T.obj K)
    let K₀ := ((restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap R₀ A₀)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj Q₀
    let K := ((restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q
    let S₀ := restrictScalars.{u}
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B₀ →ₐ[R₀] A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀).toRingHom
    let S := restrictScalars.{u}
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B).toRingHom
    let E := ((extendScalars (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj Q
    ∀ (v : T₀.obj K₀ ≅ (U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (T.obj K))
      (_hv : ∀ (j : ℤ) (b : B₀) (x : Q₀.X j),
        v.hom.f j (b ⊗ₜ[R₀,algebraMap R₀ B₀] (show K₀.X j from x)) =
          eB b ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R B] (show K.X j from q.hom.f j x))
      (f : P₀.obj K₀ ⟶ U.obj (P.obj K))
      (_hf : f ≫ U.map (c K) = c₀ K₀ ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap v.hom i ≫
        ((T.obj K).sc i |>.mapHomologyIso U).hom)
      (k : S₀.obj (M.cohomology i) ⟶ U.obj (S.obj (N.cohomology i)))
      (_hk : k ≫ U.map (N.cohomologyIso i).hom = (M.cohomologyIso i).hom ≫ f),
      ∀ x : M.cohomology i,
        ((E.sc i).mapHomologyIso (restrictScalars.{u} eE.toRingHom)).inv
            (N.comparison i (show N.cohomology i from k x)) =
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap s.hom i (M.comparison i x)
